title: U.S. awards Amkor up to $407M CHIPS grant

sources.quote: The U.S. Department of Commerce awarded Amkor Technology Arizona, Inc., a subsidiary of Amkor Technology, Inc., up to $407 million in direct funding to support the construction of a new advanced packaging and test facility.
In December 2024, Commerce awarded us up to $407 million in direct funding pursuant to the CHIPS Act for the Arizona Facility.

explain: The government agreed to give Amkor up to $407 million in grants for an advanced chip packaging and testing plant in Peoria, Arizona, the step that joins AI chips to their memory.
